
## Contact

If you need support, think about which part of your system is really causing the trouble. It could be Data Foundry, or the OOCSI connectivity. It could also be a programming problem on a specific platform (Processing, ESP, Python). 

### ID wiki

Please go to the [ID wiki](https://idwiki.tue.nl) and check the support page there for good people to ask and also **how** to ask them, so they can help you quickly.

### Teams community

You should definitely check out the [Teams community](https://teams.microsoft.com/l/team/19%3ab534445314b147d6ae6e599cdec7696c%40thread.tacv2/conversations?groupId=ce1353a0-249b-49d8-975d-98ca7e132db4&tenantId=cc7df247-60ce-4a0f-9d75-704cf60efc64). There are over 100 students and staff who can probably help you.

### Email 

For direct questions, you can email [Mathias](mailto:m.funk_at_tue.nl) or [Eden](mailto:i.chiang_at_tue.nl).
